section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section cites the Yerushalmi regarding Shimshon, explaining that he was named after the Holy One, blessed be He, and that the Philistines feared him for twenty years after his death as they did during his lifetime.
section.t: And as it says in the Yerushalmi14
[that "Shimshon is called by the name of the Holy One, blessed be He, as it is said15
'For the sun and a shield is Hashem, God'16,
and specifically as the Holy One, blessed be He, is the 'sun',
: "One verse says 'And he judged Israel forty years'18
says 'And he judged Israel twenty years, etc.' — this teaches that the Philistines feared him for twenty years after his death, just as they feared him for twenty years during his lifetime"20.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the conclusion was also after midday, which is in the closest possible proximity to the Tenth of Shevat, which in the fixed calendar of this year falls on Shabbat Kodesh.
section.t: And therefore the conclusion was also after midday,
which is in the closest possible proximity to the Tenth of Shevat,
which in the fixed calendar of this year falls on Shabbat Kodesh
(as in the year of the histalkus)

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section states that on Friday, Erev Shabbat Kodesh of Parshat Bo, the Tenth of Shevat, 5730, after midday, they completed it with a festive meal.
section.t: And indeed on Friday, Erev Shabbat Kodesh of Parshat Bo,
they completed it with a festive meal.
